title: Patch: the dungeon run asks before it throws away a run or a fight, and its map has a way back
thread:
**Issue #2972 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2972: Patch: the dungeon run asks before it throws away a run or a fight, and its map has a way back
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Three ways to lose dungeon progress by accident today:
- "Abandon the run" sits right beside "Continue the run" and ends a run several fights deep in one tap, with no question and no undo.
- During a fight, the browser's Back or a phone's back gesture silently drops the fight, which is dealt again from the first turn when you return.
- The run's map has no Back button at all, so on a phone the only way to the Play menu is the browser.

Once built, Abandon asks first, leaving a fight in progress asks and says the fight will start over, and the map has the same Back link as the run's start screen.

## Why
- `apps/web/src/dungeon/start/StartScreen.tsx:112`: `onClick={dungeon.abandon}`; `apps/web/src/dungeon/store.ts:468-475` (`abandonRun`) settles the loss and clears the saved run.
- Every other press that cannot be undone asks first: concede (`game/Game.tsx:570-573`), a token's redemption (`collection/TokenOffer.tsx`, R2480000), the chase Buy (`shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`, R2683000).
- `dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx:12-13`: "A fight is never saved (R2706000)", yet the screen has no leave guard. Practice asks before leaving a game (`routes/practice.tsx`'s leave dialog), and the online match holds every way off the board (`routes/match.tsx:329-344`, `guardLeaving` in `net/navigate.ts:40`, R2479000).
- `dungeon/map/RunScreen.tsx:97-108` draws only the run's HUD and the phase's screen; the start screen (`StartScreen.tsx:414`) and the stats page (`stats/DungeonStats.tsx:304`) have a `BackLink`.

## Proposal
- Abandon: the first press asks in place, Cancel focused and Escape cancelling, as `TokenOffer` does; only Confirm calls `abandon`.
- Fight: `guardLeaving` while the fight has no result, with a question like practice's leave dialog minus its Save and leave, saying the fight starts over. It is released on the fight's result and on the store's own screen changes.
- Map: a `BackLink` to the Play menu; the run stays saved and the start screen offers Continue.
- Each new sentence gets its `zh-CN.json` entry (R711000), and a ruling note if the confirm needs one, as R2480000 got.

## Where it lands
`apps/web/src/dungeon/start/StartScreen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/dungeon/fight/FightScreen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/dungeon/map/RunScreen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/dungeon/testids.ts`, their tests, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`; SPEC §15.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One click on Abandon does not call `abandon` and shows the question; Confirm calls it once; Cancel and Escape do not (the existing B19 test in `StartScreen.test.tsx` is updated to match).
- [ ] With a fight in progress, an in-app navigation is held and the question shown; Stay keeps the fight; once the fight has its result nothing is held.
- [ ] The run map shows a Back link to the Play menu, and following it keeps the run saved.
- [ ] The run map still fits one phone screen with its new Back link.

## Size and risks
Medium: about 6 files and their tests. The fight's guard has to release when the store, not a navigation, changes the screen (a result, Continue), or it would hold the run's own flow.
```
